tool-step: Adopt the next intention in the recipe you are following. Name the target exactly as the tip lists it: a step, stay (re-choose the current step), or an exit — done where the step offers it; ask and abort at any step. For ask: write the question in your text first, then call recipe_step with ask; the turn ends there and the user answers.
tool-step-target: the step to adopt, or stay, done, ask, abort
tool-step-note: optional one line for the run log
tool-enter: Enter a recipe: a thought process this clanker holds, followed step by step with the recipe_step tool once entered. Recipes on offer: {recipes}.
tool-enter-recipe: the recipe to enter, by name
tool-enter-level: the budget level; normal when omitted
step-ask: waiting on the user: end this turn with the question
step-back: ; back in {name} at {step}: name an arrow from there
waiting: waiting on the user: {name} at {step} asks
asked: ASKED      the user has not answered yet: end this turn with the question
ask-default: you cannot go on without the user
abort-default: giving up is the right outcome
